evals.name: dashboard-chart-bundle-cls-waterfall
evals.expected_output: Filled template. Should flag: moment added (~70KB, no tree-shaking) for one fromNow -> Intl.RelativeTimeFormat or date-fns; full lodash for one groupBy -> lodash/groupBy or four-line inline; import * as Icons from lucide-react defeating tree-shaking; chart.js + react-chartjs-2 imported eagerly on a dashboard route -> lazy/dynamic; loading=lazy on the hero image delaying LCP; the enrollments query gated on term?.code creating a request waterfall; the scroll handler reading getBoundingClientRect per item on every scroll event (layout thrash, unthrottled); only isLoading handled -> no error state, plus enrollments[0] crashes when the list is empty; chart animation with no prefers-reduced-motion consideration; hard-coded #C9A227 instead of the primary token. Should quantify bundle impact with a number or say the basis for the estimate. Should not stray into server-side/DB performance.
assertions: Flags moment as a heavy dependency for its single use and names a lighter alternative
Flags the full lodash import for one groupBy and recommends the submodule import or inline code
Flags 'import * as Icons' as defeating tree-shaking
Flags eagerly importing chart.js / react-chartjs-2 and recommends lazy or dynamic loading
Flags loading=lazy on the above-the-fold hero image as delaying LCP
Flags the request waterfall (enrollments query cannot start until the term query resolves)
Flags the scroll handler reading getBoundingClientRect per item as layout thrash or unthrottled work
Flags the missing error state and/or the enrollments[0] access that breaks on empty data
Quantifies at least one bundle cost with a number or states the basis for the estimate
Output uses the review template with Reviewer, Model, Visual check, and Verdict fields filled in
Does not present server-side or database performance findings as its own scope

evals.name: shared-button-blast-radius-precision
evals.expected_output: Filled template. Should flag: the kind->variant rename as a breaking change across ~40 call sites (only one updated in this diff) and recommend grepping/updating all callers; the defaultVariants size change md->sm silently shrinking every button that does not pass size explicitly; the focus indicator change from focus-visible:ring to focus:shadow with a hard-coded gold #F2CC0C (focus now shows on mouse click too, gold on light backgrounds is roughly 1.6:1 and fails the 3:1 non-text requirement, and it hard-codes a color instead of --color-ring); the in-place --color-primary change from #C9A227 to #F2CC0C, which changes every primary surface app-wide and breaks white-text-on-primary contrast. Should NOT flag: the index key in the static Storybook variants array, the 16x16 info icon lacking dimensions, the @axe-core/react devDependency as bundle cost, the inline style in the stories file. Should stay precise rather than padding the review.
assertions: Flags the kind -> variant rename as a breaking change and recommends finding/updating all call sites
Flags the defaultVariants size change from md to sm as silently shrinking existing buttons
Flags the focus indicator regression (focus-visible ring replaced by a hard-coded gold focus shadow), citing contrast or focus-visible vs focus behavior
Flags the in-place --color-primary token change and its app-wide/contrast consequences
Does NOT flag the index key in the static Storybook variants list as a real bug
Does NOT flag the 16x16 info icon img for missing dimensions or layout shift
Does NOT flag the @axe-core/react devDependency as a bundle cost
Output uses the review template with Reviewer, Model, Visual check, and Verdict fields filled in
Stays precise: 8 or fewer distinct findings, no padding with speculative issues
